description: Make and change a Motion artifact: a short animated film (an explainer, a product promo or walkthrough, a launch, recruiting or event clip, a toast, a title or end card, an animated story) whose scenes are HTML, CSS and JavaScript drawn as a pure function of time, with a generated score and, where you can record one, a captioned voiceover. Its content is the artifact's own document store (small JSON documents under db/), written through ArtifactData under a host or `open-artifact write-db` locally, never as free-form files. Use for any of those, and when someone sends a request or a comment from a film's page.
